references.text: Both verses confirm the historical and theological fulfillment of God's command to fill the earth through Noah's sons.
The verses serve as an introduction and conclusion to the same 'genealogy' structure, consistently affirming that nations descend from Noah's sons.
The connection shows continuity from Noah's personal righteousness before the flood to the spread of his descendants after the flood.
The verses are parts of the same text passage where 10:5 gives a concrete example of the general dispersion summarized in 10:32.
